name: n313_silence_restored_only
description: Isolated test of n313_silence_restored. User asks 'Робот, теперь тихо?' — robot must answer «тишина» from <music_state> (player snapshot, issue #3165; before that PR #2387 required get_music_state). Pre-conditions: DJ mode disabled, stop_music called to ensure no music playing.

steps.label: pre_clear_dj_and_music
steps._why: Cleanup: stop any music and disable DJ mode (post-condition for n313).

expected_keywords: тишин|тихо|ничего не играет|не играет|не звучит|музыки нет
acceptance._comment: Issue #3165 (was #2347 / PR #2387): <music_state> is the player snapshot (#3161, ADR-0141), so the answer comes from it; get_music_state is no longer mandatory. Live run 29.09: the mandatory tool punished the correct «тишина» with retries and «Не получилось выполнить». We check the answer itself.
